page_title: VAL 1-1 ELC | Valencia v Elche 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90+5' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) is cautioned by the referee after being shown a yellow card for dissent.
90+5' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90+4' Pepelu (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Ortiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+2' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
90+2' The ball goes out of play and Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.

88' Matias Dituro was forced into action to thwart Largie Ramazani (Valencia). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Matias Dituro.
86' Pepelu (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

86' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Grady Diangana (Elche) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Valencia!
86' Pepelu (Valencia) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
83' Elche can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Here is a change. Aleix Febas is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).
79' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Miguel Ortiz stops the game and makes a call.
77' It is time for a substitution. Javi Guerra is on for Filip Ugrinic (Valencia).
77' Here's the change. Diego Lopez (Valencia) leaves the pitch and Largie Ramazani comes on as a substitute.

75' 0 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Grady Diangana (Elche) and Adria Pedrosa gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the left side of the goal. 0:1.
74' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Alvaro Nunez and he is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
74' A substitution has been made. Martim Neto is replaced by Grady Diangana (Elche).
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Victor Chust (Elche) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' The attendance is 44949.
69' The resulting set piece from Elche is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Aleix Febas (Elche) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Elche force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
66' The referee blows his whistle as Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) was too aggressive in his challenge.
65' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Umar Sadiq (Valencia) replacing Lucas Beltran.
65' That will be all from Andre Almeida who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia).
64' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Alvaro Nunez (Elche) for his blatant foul.
63' Neat passing move from Elche in order to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Yago Santiago will be replaced by Adam Boayar (Elche).
60' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pedro Bigas limps off the pitch to be replaced by David Affengruber (Elche).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filip Ugrinic departs the field of play to be replaced by Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
59' It will be a substitution. Javi Guerra (Valencia) is ready to enter the pitch as Diego Lopez walks off.
57' Looks like Pedro Bigas (Elche) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
56' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
54' The corner is swung in but Elche can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Pepelu (Valencia) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
51' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Martim Neto (Elche). Another situation results in a direct free kick for Valencia.
51' Valencia are seeing far more of the ball now.
48' Diego Lopez (Valencia) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

47' What an opportunity! Pepelu (Valencia) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
46' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Elche failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+4' The free kick from long range, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Elche are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Andre Almeida (Valencia), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

45' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a shot towards the roof of the net, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Elche is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

41' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Matias Dituro was alert and the score remains the same.

38' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
37' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valencia.
37' Jose Copete (Valencia) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
35' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
32' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Matias Dituro (Elche).
30' Luis Rioja (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Valencia win a corner kick.
28' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
27' Luis Rioja (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Valencia will take a corner kick.
26' Elche are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
23' Good movement by Leo Petrot (Elche), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.

21' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.

18' Diego Lopez (Valencia) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
17' Thierry Correia is being substituted because of an injury. Carlos Corberan sends Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) on the pitch.
16' The game is interrupted now, Thierry Correia (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' Thierry Correia (Valencia) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

13' Luis Rioja (Valencia) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
12' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Miguel Ortiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Victor Chust (Elche) and blew his whistle.
7' Elche enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Luis Rioja (Valencia) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
3' German Valera (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
3' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Elche will kick-off.
